title: Exponential cutoff identity
statement:
For every real $\varepsilon>0$ and every real $\delta$,
\[
\exp\!\left(-\delta\,\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{3}\right)=\varepsilon^{\delta/3}.
\]
